task.title: Removing a geo-replicated site from your standalone Red Hat Quay deployment
task.shortdesc: To remove a geo-replicated site from a standalone Red Hat Quay deployment, you can sync blobs between sites, update config.yaml, and run the removelocation utility.

ul.li: You have configured Red Hat Quay geo-replication with at least two sites, for example, usstorage and eustorage.
Each site has its own Organization, Repository, and image tags.
